messages:
maria: quick sync  i'm drafting a compact handshake for runtime hedges vs control-plane cutovers. want something minimal that supports emergency cutouts + smooth ramps.

ken: yes please. runtime = fast local mitigations (bounded); control-plane = authoritative state & weights. main goals: avoid double-mitigation, cap cost, keep audits simple.

rafa: propose three lease types: CUTOUT (immediate stop new allocs), RAMP (target_weight + duration), and QUARANTINE (investigate then drain). leases signed ed25519. runtime verifies signer id and rev.

olivia: runtime hedges allowed only within variant-family and only when HedgeBudget tokens available. config: max_extra_rps, max_multiplier. runtime emits hedged_request_count and adds header "X-Redwood-Hedged".

maria: drain semantics: on CUTOUT/QUARANTINE runtime marks DRAINING, stop new allocations, allow inflight up to drain_grace_ms (default 20s). emit reconcile event: lease_id, host_id, before_inflight, after_inflight.

ken: smoothing: runtime uses token-bucket per-variant to ramp to target weight, bounded by delta_per_second. orchestrator supplies target_weight + lease_ttl + rev.

rafa: probe contract: compact protobuf ProbeWindow { window_start, window_end, p95_ms, error_count, hedged_count }. defaults: errors=15s, latency=30s. sample 1/1000 full traces.

olivia: telemetry: every trace should include variant_token and lease_id. SDK example: trace.add_tag("variant_token", token); trace.add_tag("lease_id", "L-546789");

maria: UX: console shows lease TTL, reason, signer, and an "escalate" button to convert to eviction. TTL auto-evaluates recovery but rejoin requires staged ramp or operator approve.

ken: edge: old leases arriving late -> use monotonic rev numbers; runtime ignores rev < current_rev. host restart -> reconcile via /leases/reconcile or SSE stream.

rafa: security: sign with ed25519, include key-id; control-plane rotates keys with short grace window.

olivia: action items: ken -> lease proto + rev rules; rafa -> ProbeWindow proto + sampling; maria -> SDK tags + hedgebudget metrics; eng -> SSE subscription + polling fallback.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "lease-handshake-v2" enabled in staging @ 2026-05-04T09:31:00Z :rocket:

maria: thanks all  i'll draft the RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and a tiny ref impl. :thumbsup:
